changes: Relative imports use explicit TypeScript extensions for NodeNext.
Strict optional TypeScript properties are passed conditionally.
Read-only canvas disables mutation/deletion and exposes node kind/status labels.
Layout declares its graph type locally; clipboard editing module is not included.
Node header/body use explicit slots so the React Flow port divs are not styled as card content.
Layout accepts an explicit stable node order; tools use canonical sequence order while record-order edges do not determine hierarchy columns.
Read-only edge labels are focusable selection buttons connected to the same inspector.
Existing pyd-flow-group renderer adds explicit membership-basis/count summaries and keyboard collapse/enter actions; native cowork nodes remain distinct from visual containers.
Optional viewport focus fits an entered group or revealed native member after node initialization, with parent/global navigation owned by Track.
Layout spaces dependency columns using their maximum actual node/group width instead of a fixed width to avoid overlapping expanded groups.

items.name: pyd-flow-clipboard
items.reason: Inspected type dependency only; clipboard editing code is not shipped.
